overview_description.description:
OffDeal is building an AI-native investment bank for buying and selling small businesses.

We use custom AI agents and big data to screen thousands of SMBs each day, matching buyers with the perfect acquisition target in days instead of months. Unlike legacy M&A advisors, we can search for targets for hundreds of buyers concurrently, 24/7.

product.name: AI Buyer Match
product.description: An AI-driven tool that identifies and matches small businesses with strategic buyers based on sector expertise and business characteristics.

product.name: M&A Advisory Services
product.description: End-to-end advisory support for small business owners to facilitate the sale of their businesses, including guidance, negotiation, and transaction management.

product.name: Buyer Network Access
product.description: A platform that connects business sellers with a network of over 15 times more buyers, enabling competitive auctions and higher offer prices.

product.name: Seller Financing Guidance
product.description: Consultative service that helps small business owners structure and negotiate seller financing deals to facilitate business sales.

product.name: Search Fund Sale Advisory
product.description: Specialized advisory service for business owners considering selling to search fund buyers, including deal structuring and transition planning.
